biology_summary: Mouse mdx (Dmd-null) is too mild; adding utrophin loss yields a much more human-like severe dystrophic phenotype. Textbook case that ortholog-only KO is insufficient for DMD modeling.

ABCD2 functionally overlaps with ABCD1; combined perturbation or Abcd2-aware interpretation yields a more faithful X-ALD model. Tests whether the model elevates a compensatory paralog rather than stopping at the ortholog.

mapping_pattern: 1 human tumor suppressor -> mouse multi-gene compensatory model
biology_summary: Mouse Rb1 loss alone under-recapitulates human RB1 disease because p107 (Rbl1) compensates; combined perturbation is disease-relevant. Cancer-model example of non-1:1 functional alignment.
Mouse lacks a simple SHOX ortholog; Shox2 carries the closest disease-relevant developmental function. Non-ortholog example showing why orthology lookup alone fails.
Human AAT deficiency maps onto a mouse locus expanded into multiple endogenous paralogs; quintuple KO recapitulates disease-relevant phenotype. Clean one-to-many benchmark.

Simple mouse Cftr perturbation does not reliably reproduce classic human CF lung disease; betaENaC (Scnn1b)-driven airway disease is much closer phenotypically. Pathway-level rather than gene-level substitute.

Human telomere disease phenotypes often require more than a simple mouse telomerase-deficiency model; Pot1b plus telomerase/Terc reduction is much closer. Multi-hit module benchmark (mixed features of A_promote and compensatory module).

mapping_pattern: Disease-module alignment rather than single-gene mapping
biology_summary: Down syndrome driving concept: Ts65Dn phenotypes are materially shaped by non-Hsa21-orthologous Mmu17 genes. Gene-set/module-level example for disease-signature inputs. Mouse gold set lists representative Hsa21 orthologs on Mmu16 expressed in Ts65Dn; driving concept symbol used in human column.

Rodents lack a direct IL8 ortholog; these murine chemokines together carry the closest neutrophil-recruiting function. Important module-level benchmark for inflammatory signatures; CXCL8/CXCR2 axis is a translational drug target class (repertaxin/danirixin).
Human TLR8 biology in mice is better approximated by Tlr13-like RNA sensing than by assuming murine Tlr8 is equivalent. Receptor-level non-ortholog case with immuno-oncology TLR8 agonist relevance.
Mouse NK inhibition/education is carried by Ly49 (Klra) receptors, not a true KIR ortholog system. Family/module benchmark for inhibitory NK programs; NK engager therapeutics relevance.
Siglec-F is the closest disease-relevant murine functional paralog of human Siglec-8, especially in eosinophilic inflammation. SIGLEC-8 is a biologics target (lirentelimab).
PirB carries the closest murine disease-relevant receptor function to human LILRB2 in synaptic-plasticity/amyloid biology. LILRB2 is a myeloid-checkpoint antibody target.

Murine Mmp1 genes do not behave as clean human MMP1 substitutes; Mmp13 is often the more disease-relevant collagenase node in mouse pathology (OA/arthritis). MMP1/MMP13 are arthritis protease drug targets.

mapping_pattern: 1 human gene -> mouse expanded paralog module
biology_summary: Human NAIP function is distributed across multiple murine Naip paralogs with ligand-specific specialization. Excellent one-to-many module benchmark; NAIP is an inflammasome drug target node. PMC4854738 cited (no numeric PMID in greatcases.md).

Siglec-E is the best murine functional equivalent for much of human Siglec-9 biology. Checkpoint/myeloid inhibitory program benchmark; Siglec-9 is a checkpoint therapy target. Mechanistic support PMC3596968.
The murine NKG2D ligand system (Rae-1, H60, Mult1) uses a different gene set to instantiate the same stress-activation logic as human MICA/MICB/ULBPs. Module-level immune-surveillance benchmark.

Murine FcgammaRIV is often the best endogenous effector node for human FcgammaRIIIa biology, especially in antibody effector contexts. FcgammaRIIIa is a translational immunotherapy target class. PMC3341029 cited (no numeric PMID).

mapping_pattern: Human two-gene module -> mouse single node
biology_summary: Human caspase-4/5 biology is compressed into a single murine caspase-11 (MGI gene symbol Casp4) for cytosolic LPS sensing and pyroptosis. Many-to-one innate-immunity benchmark; inflammasome inhibitor drug class. Note: MGI-approved symbol for the mouse 'caspase-11' gene is Casp4.

Siglec-G is the closest murine counterpart for human Siglec-10, especially in danger-discrimination circuits. Checkpoint-logic benchmark; SIGLEC10 is a CD24Fc/checkpoint target. PMC4116048 cited (no numeric PMID).

The damage-associated molecular pattern discrimination circuit is carried by CD24/SIGLEC10 in human and Cd24a/Siglec-G in mouse. Module-level positive for immune regulation; CD24-SIGLEC10 axis is a clinical drug target (CD24Fc). PMC2765686 cited (no numeric PMID).

mapping_pattern: 1 human gene -> mouse expanded paralog cluster
biology_summary: Mouse Nlrp1 locus is expanded and mechanistically divergent; the closest endogenous mapping is a paralog cluster rather than a simple 1:1 point. Inflammasome-family benchmark; NLRP1 inflammasome drug target. PMC5142783 cited (no numeric PMID).

mapping_pattern: Human receptor program -> mouse family module
biology_summary: Murine Cd209-family genes, especially SIGNR1 (MGI-approved symbol Cd209b), carry the closest pathogen-binding lectin logic to human DC-SIGN/DC-SIGNR. One-to-many receptor-family benchmark.

Qa-1b (MGI-approved symbol H2-T23) is the best murine functional analog to HLA-E, though not perfectly equivalent. Inhibitory/NK education benchmark; HLA-E checkpoint axis is a drug target. PMC5788890 cited (no numeric PMID).

Lilrb4a/gp49B is the closest disease-relevant murine analog for human LILRB4, despite non-orthologous genomic positioning. Checkpoint and myeloid suppressor biology; LILRB4 is a checkpoint mAb target. PMC11977387 cited (no numeric PMID).

Mrgprb2 is the key murine endogenous node used to model much of human MRGPRX2 biology in mast cells. Disease-relevant analog; MRGPRX2 is a pseudoallergy drug target. PMC8355064 cited (no numeric PMID).

Receptor-inclusive restatement of CXCL8 axis emphasizing murine counterpart as ligand-receptor module (Cxcl1/2/5 + Cxcr2-dominant axis). Useful for disease-signature/pathway-level scoring; CXCR2 antagonists are a translational drug class.

mapping_pattern: 1 human gene -> mouse expanded gene family
biology_summary: Human IRGM biology maps imperfectly onto an expanded murine Irgm family (Irgm1/Irgm2 with Irgm3 as Igtp paralog context); Irgm1 is the main disease-relevant node. Strong family-expansion example with colitis/IBD relevance.
Qa-2 (H2-Q7/H2-Q9) is widely treated as the closest murine functional counterpart to HLA-G in tolerance/reproductive immunology. Nonclassical-MHC analog; HLA-G is a checkpoint target.

Murine FPR family is expanded and partially repartitioned (Fpr2, Fpr-rs1/rs3, Fpr3); the closest endogenous mapping is a receptor module. Receptor-family benchmark; FPR2 is a pro-resolving drug target (ACT-389949). PMC5705339 cited (no numeric PMID). Note: Fpr-rs3 is MGI symbol for Fpr-rs1-like.

IFI16 and p204/Ifi204 are the closest cross-species functional pair in the p200 family (alt name p204), with inflammatory and bone-loss relevance. Innate-immunity single-node analog. PMC4372153 cited (no numeric PMID).
Several papers suggest murine Ccl8 as a tentative functional analog of human CCL18; mapping is debated. Relaxed-threshold only. PMC11389940 cited (no numeric PMID).

Human and murine CLCA families do not map cleanly; the MGI-approved symbol for the previously-named murine Clca3/gob5 mucin-inducer is Clca1, with broader Clca-family context. Relaxed-threshold module. PMC2653474 cited (no numeric PMID). Note: nomenclature is confusing between species.
Clec10a has been identified as the closest murine functional homolog for human ASGR1 in skin/homeostatic inflammatory contexts. Clean non-ortholog analog.
Murine mast-cell protease 4 (Mcpt4) is the accepted endogenous functional counterpart for much of human chymase (CMA1) biology. Effector-protease benchmark. PMC2194091 cited (no numeric PMID).

FHR-E (MGI-approved symbol Cfhr1) is treated as the murine homolog of human FHR1 and has direct sepsis/AKI phenotype support. Strong complement-family endogenous analog; complement therapeutics relevance.

mapping_pattern: Human multi-gene module -> mouse single node
biology_summary: Humans have a seven-gene APOBEC3 cluster; mouse compresses the corresponding antiviral restriction logic into a single Apobec3 locus. Many-to-one endogenous benchmark; APOBEC3 HIV-context drug relevance. PMC7692085/PMC8310219 cited (no numeric PMIDs).
Fv1 and TRIM5alpha (HGNC-approved symbol TRIM5) are not direct orthologs but carry strikingly parallel capsid-restriction logic. Non-ortholog antiviral analog; HIV restriction drug relevance.

In humans the dominant circulating short pentraxin is CRP; in mice the closest endogenous acute-phase counterpart is SAP/Apcs. Note: there is also expression-level compensation (murine Crp exists but is minor), so this is dominantly B_substitute with a minor compression flavor.
In lung and type-2 inflammatory contexts, RELMalpha/Retnla often serves as the closest murine counterpart to human resistin (RETN). Context dependent. PMC6864303 cited (no numeric PMID).

mapping_pattern: Human small module -> mouse expanded family module
biology_summary: Mouse eosinophil-associated RNases (Ear family, incl. Ear1/2/11) represent an expanded family carrying the closest endogenous logic to human EDN/ECP (RNASE2/RNASE3) eosinophil cationic RNases.

Mouse splits mannose-binding lectin biology across Mbl1 and Mbl2, making this a clean one-to-many benchmark. Complement/lectin module example; MBL2 is a complement therapeutics target. Review cited without numeric PMID.

mapping_pattern: Human two-gene module -> mouse single locus
biology_summary: Mouse compresses the human CR1/CR2 receptor architecture into a single Cr2 locus that generates CR1/CR2-like products via splicing. Architectural many-to-one benchmark; complement regulation drug target. PMC3366432 cited (no numeric PMID).

Although Oasl1 is more sequence-similar, Oasl2 is the functionally closer murine counterpart for human OASL antiviral activity. Example where function beats sequence (mixed: A_promote-like since Oasl1 is the naive ortholog but insufficient; functional answer is Oasl2 or module). PMC4351405/PMC4101812 cited (no numeric PMIDs).

Murine Mcpt6 (MGI-approved symbol Tpsb2) is the accepted endogenous functional counterpart for much of human beta-tryptase (TPSAB1/TPSB2) biology, with arthritis/tumor-model relevance. Effector-program benchmark; tryptase drug targets. PMC4225174 cited (no numeric PMID).

Although mice have a restricted Cd46 locus, the broadly acting murine endogenous complement regulator most analogous in function to human CD46/MCP is Crry (MGI-approved symbol Cr1l). Complement-regulator benchmark; anti-C5/complement drug relevance. Also cites PMC2580744.

Humans have one principal CD55; mice have duplicated DAF loci with Cd55 (Cd55a) as the broadly relevant systemic node plus Cd55b. Duplication-aware complement benchmark; complement therapeutics relevance.
Murine CD59 biology is split across Cd59a (primary systemic) and Cd59b, with distinct tissue bias and phenotype impact. Complement duplication benchmark; complement therapeutics relevance.
The mouse NKR-P1B:Clr-b (Klrb1b:Clec2d) axis is the clearest endogenous inhibitory counterpart to the human CD161:LLT1 (KLRB1:CLEC2D) system. Module-level checkpoint benchmark. Also cites PMC6218473.
Murine CD1d biology is split across Cd1d1 and Cd1d2, which are not fully redundant. Clean antigen-presentation duplication benchmark; CD1D is a drug target class in iNKT biology.

Chemokine family nomenclature and disease data suggest Ccl6/Ccl9 as the closest murine endogenous correspondents to human CCL23/CCL15 in the extended CCR1 space. Family-level; relaxed-threshold module. No numeric PMID cited.

Mouse Slfn8/Slfn9 can complement SLFN11-deficient human cells, making this a strong one-to-many endogenous substitute. Mechanistic benchmark outside immunology; SLFN11 is a PARP/DDR synthetic lethality biomarker. Note: mouse Slfn11 exists but is not the closest functional counterpart, so subtype is dominantly B_substitute with A_promote features.

Human FcepsilonRI(alphagamma) chain genes (MS4A2/FCER1G) and murine FcgammaRIV (Fcgr4) share a similar effector-cell deployment logic. Category B/C bridge; FcR therapeutics. JCI article cited without numeric PMID.

Human IgG4 (IGHG4) and mouse IgG1 (Ighg1) map at the isotype level for anti-inflammatory effector logic; useful for IgG4-related disease modeling. Not a classic gene-to-gene perturbation mapping; expanded-threshold only.

mapping_pattern: Human two-gene program -> mouse single node
biology_summary: Mouse MHC-I peptide trimming is centered on ERAAP/Erap1, which collapses much of the human ERAP1/ERAP2 function into one endogenous node. Many-to-one antigen-processing benchmark. PMC7140696 cited (no numeric PMID).

Human ILT7(LILRA4)-BST2 and mouse Siglec-H (Siglech) occupy parallel pDC-restricted inhibitory niches controlling type-I IFN responses. Mechanistic supporting case; ILT7 is a pDC therapeutics target. PMC2919054 cited (no numeric PMID).

Recent literature argues that murine Alox8 is the best counterpart to human ALOX15B and that humanizing this axis changes colitis susceptibility. Disease-relevant metabolic benchmark; IBD lipid mediator drug target.
